privacy.title: Clear information about how your contact details are used.
privacy.intro: This unified notice describes, in plain language, how data collected through the institutional website and the CAP Cotações platform is used by CAP Câmbio.
privacy.s1x: Contact channels may request your name, email, phone number, and message. Avoid including bank details, passwords, documents, or sensitive information in messages.
privacy.s2x: Information is recorded to respond to service requests, prepare a quote when applicable, and maintain basic contact history.
privacy.s3x: The website uses cookies and measurement technologies, with your consent, to understand site usage and improve the platform experience.
privacy.s4x: Access to requests is restricted to the responsible service team. CAP Câmbio must continuously evaluate its internal security and data retention practices.
privacy.s5x: For questions about a submitted contact request, use the official channels listed on this page and provide the necessary information to locate your request.

terms.title: Transparency before any operation.
terms.intro: These unified terms cover the institutional website and the CAP Cotações platform. Any operation must be confirmed directly with CAP Câmbio.
terms.s1x: Information available on the platform is for reference and tracking purposes only. It does not represent a proposal, reservation, guaranteed rate, or final contracting condition.
terms.s2x: Conditions, currency availability, required documents, and timelines vary by operation. Confirm these details with a specialist before making a decision.
terms.s3x: The texts and elements on this website do not replace specific financial, legal, accounting, or tax advice for your situation.
terms.s4x: Institutional and operational content may be updated to reflect changes in services and service channels.
